title: fieldwork-db::articles_db — long-form article storage with drafts
description: Articles differ from Notes: they have titles, slugs (URL-friendly), draft/published state, featured images, reading time estimates, series/collections, and typically much longer content (10K+ chars). Schema: articles table (id, user_id, persona_id, title, slug, content, content_html, excerpt, featured_media_id, state: draft/published/unlisted, language, reading_time_mins, series_id, ap_id, created_at, published_at, updated_at). Series table for multi-part articles. Tags junction.
